extractionMethod: HTML fetched verbatim from the public SEC URLs above via curl. Plain text derived via a simple, generic HTML-to-text conversion (strip <script>/<style> blocks, convert block-level closing tags to newlines, strip remaining tags, decode HTML entities, normalize whitespace) - never any LLM/AI involvement in extraction; deterministic and reproducible from the preserved raw .htm files. No content was deleted, reordered, or summarized - table of contents, section numbering, and exhibit/schedule text are preserved in full.
honestSizeDisclosure: This materially EXCEEDS the mission's own Section 4 guidance of 'approximately 2-4 core documents and roughly 75-250 pages total' - by roughly 2x on the page dimension. This is disclosed transparently, not hidden: the issuer was selected by a pre-committed deterministic formula (02-selection.json) before any document text was opened, and Superior Industries' real Term Loan Credit Agreement (a $400M-then-$520M syndicated facility) is genuinely this long - real financing documents of this type routinely run 200+ pages. Re-selecting a different, smaller candidate after observing this size would itself violate the mission's own 'no human hand-picking after seeing document contents' discipline (character/page count is content-derived, not pool metadata). The mission's own explicit, enumerated hard-stop conditions are the $8 AI-cost ceiling (Section 9) and source validity (Section 6) - not a page-count ceiling - so this validation proceeds, relying on the REAL production pipeline's own existing deterministic discovery/routing and cost-bounded semantic-compilation scoping (the same mechanism that kept prior real large-document runs, e.g. Phase 3F/post-3F2's own Riot/known-package runs, within single-digit-dollar cost despite comparably large source documents) to keep actual incremental AI spend low regardless of total page count. The cost forecast in 06-cost-forecast.json will independently confirm this before any substantive spend, and the validation will stop per Section 9 if it does not.
immutabilityCommitment: No document will be added to or removed from this 3-document set after this point, regardless of how the pipeline or scoring subsequently performs on it (Section 6's own explicit rule).
